name: Arsenal
author: tidic84
description: Firearms, explosives and ship weapons in the game's style. Bullets drill round holes through hull panels with penetration levels per weapon and different resistance per material (glass, wood, iron, ricochets); every hull piece (slopes and corners too) can be holed and broken; explosions wreck thrusters, tanks and other machinery. 15 hand weapons (gauss, plasma, railgun, laser minigun, flamethrower, Tesla arc, disintegrator, launchers...) made at an armory terminal, PvP with hit markers and kill feed. SAM launcher with auto lock-on. Gunner seat, machine gun, homing missiles, laser, point defence, plasma, ion, railgun, torpedo, rocket pod and self-aiming SAM battery. Blasts push ships off course. Multiplayer: every player needs the mod.
